quran.note: Her mother vows what is in her womb; Maryam is accepted and put in Zakariya’s care, and finds provision with her.
The angels say Allah has chosen and purified her; she is given news of a word from Him.
She withdraws; the angel comes and she is told of a pure boy; she gives birth by a palm tree.
Maryam daughter of Imran guarded her chastity, believed in the words of her Lord and was devoutly obedient.
She and her son are made a sign for the worlds.

hadith.summary: The Prophet ﷺ said that many men reached perfection but, among women, only Asiya the wife of Pharaoh and Maryam daughter of Imran.
The Prophet ﷺ said that Satan touches every child at birth, except Maryam and her son.
Asked by the Christians of Najran about “sister of Harun”, the Prophet ﷺ said people used to take the names of prophets and righteous predecessors.

scholarly.work: Tafsir Ibn Kathir (abridged English edition, read on Quran.com)
scholarly.author: Ibn Kathir
scholarly.summary: Says Allah accepted her through her mother’s vow and Zakariya was her guardian. Ibn Ishaq and Ibn Jarir say he was the husband of her maternal aunt; the text also mentions a Sahih report that he was her brother-in-law. Mujahid, Ikrimah, Qatadah and others said she had summer fruits in winter and winter fruits in summer.

scholarly.work: Tafsir Ibn Kathir (abridged English edition, read on Quran.com)
scholarly.author: Ibn Kathir
scholarly.summary: Gives three explanations of “sister of Harun” and prefers none.
